description: This script is a test suite for Git submodule path handling, verifying behaviors when dealing with paths that include dashes, spaces, and other edge cases. It sets up repositories, adds submodules with specific path characteristics, and runs tests to confirm correct handling and error conditions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expected to succeed, with a descriptive label and a block of commands.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers a cleanup command to run after the test finishes.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Checks if the specified pattern exists in the given output or file.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Verifies that the executed command fails as expected.
